query:
SELECT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM git_sync_synced_head h
               WHERE h.workspace_id = $1 AND h.branch = $3 AND h.sha = $2
           ) AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
               FROM v2_job_queue q
               JOIN v2_job j ON j.id = q.id
               WHERE q.workspace_id = $1
                 AND j.kind IN ('dependencies', 'flowdependencies', 'appdependencies')
           ) as "ready!"
